component.name: Alibi VMS
component.summary: Live view, playback and clip download for Alibi NVRs

description.p: Desktop viewer for Alibi (Uniview-OEM) NVRs across many sites: live grid, PTZ, synced playback with a recording timeline, and clip download to MP4. Reaches each NVR directly or through a Star4Live account.
Alibi VMS is an independent project. It is not made, endorsed or supported by Alibi Security, Uniview or Star4Live, and is not affiliated with them.
PTZ controls no longer stop responding or leave a camera moving after a button is let go. Live cameras that fail to start now try again by themselves.
Live cameras whose picture freezes, or that connect but never show a picture, now reconnect by themselves. On Windows, the icons in the header bar, menus and camera list are back.

Camera thumbnails load for every camera, including on large Star4Live sites, and cloud cameras start faster. Video no longer flashes green on macOS as it starts, and the app no longer opens the Add site dialog on first launch.

Adds a button to reconnect all cameras at once (F5) and tells you when a newer version is out. AppImages are back after failing to build in 0.1.1, and the Windows installer now waits for the app to be closed before updating.
AppImages can update themselves in place. Fixes the macOS builds, which failed at code signing.
